threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You order a flat white and still ask for regular milk. The barista's side-eye says it all.
Caught a glimpse of a couple arguing over a takeaway on the 35 last night. Ended with him walking off while she polished off his burger. Classic Brixton.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The day I saw an old man serenading a flock of pigeons with an accordion in Herrmannplatz. That’s when it clicked.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain can you find a bar serving cocktails in old shoe polish cans. It’s quirky and charming, just like the locals.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a local by how they instantly know to avoid the Civic Center BART entrance during a smoke scare. Tourists just stand there confused.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy pull a whole pizza out of his backpack on the 14, while a kid tried to sell him an invisible dog. Classic SF chaos.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists always assume every plaza is for sunbathing. The locals know, the real life happens in the shadows of the trees, not on the scorching tiles.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by the way they stare blankly at the bus schedule, still expecting it to follow a schedule.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think it's normal to use the Tube for a two-stop journey. Everyone else just hops on a bus or cycles now.
Caught a couple arguing over who spent more at the bar, still waiting for the stop, but the whole bus had popcorn ready for the showdown.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The exact moment was when I caught the scent of fresh kebabs drifting through the air during a late-night walk, mingling with the sounds of laughter from a backyard party.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find hidden parks like Viktoriapark, where locals gather for sunset views, blending nature with the city's raw vibe.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s a local when they can name at least three taco spots that have been around longer than they have.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a couple of tourists trying to figure out the Muni map while the bus just passed them by. Classic SF moment, right? They looked utterly lost.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think the little dogs everywhere are 'just cute'—but those pooches are more often the guardians of their owners' taverna secrets.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can spot them by their confused faces trying to navigate the metro maps, especially when staring at the R1 and R4 lines post-fire disruption.
